decisions.reason: The data format plug-ins sit at the core of the firm's data integration expertise and standards work, so the firm can readily interpret feedback and keep improving them through its own R&D.

The building digital twin draws on the firm's geospatial know-how and research ties and fits its strategic direction, but its newer BIM knowledge base and modest web presence leave it less secure than the core offers.

Authentication and identity delegation is close to the firm's security components and easy to maintain, though the withdrawal of the related identity service raises the chance it is consolidated into the platform offer.

The open GIS application development framework is central to the firm's strategy of open, extensible components, and its developers and research activity give it strong capacity to evolve the framework.
The geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's consulting and training experience, has its own page, and lets the firm learn quickly from customer contact.
